 Order
06.08.2025 Heard Mr. A.J. Saikia, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is directed against the judgment and award dated 25.04.2025 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT),
Tinsukia, Assam, in MAC Case No.48/2023.

entities.text:
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT),
Tinsukia, Assam
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and award dated 25.04.2025, the learned Tribunal has directed the appellant herein to pay a sum of Rs.2,77,469/- being the compensation to the respondent No.1/claimant herein and to recover the same from the respondent No.2.

Mr. Saikia, learned counsel for the appellant submits that the award was passed under the new Act and in the new Act there is no provision for pay and recovery and as such, the impugned judgment and award is illegal and arbitrary and therefore, it is contended to interfere with the same.
The submission of Mr. Saikia needs further consideration.
At this stage, admit the appeal.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
Step be taken by registered post with A/D and also by usual process within a week from today.
Registry shall call for the record from the learned Tribunal.

Sd/- Robin Phukan JUDGE Comparing Assistant And One Of The Branch Office At B.R. ... vs Hemonti Sharma And 2 Others on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172599750/
